LibTmux.Query.ClientAttachment

Description

Selected session, window and pane of a captured client.

Use with LibTmux.Query and LibTmux.Query.Client. All tokens describe the tmux 3.3a baseline. The selected PaneOccurrence keeps the client's actual window-link index rather than choosing another link to that window.
